name: TEWIRROW
summary: Amazon brand selling 1 kg PLA (basic, matte, Silk+, silk dual/multi-colour, marble) as spools and spoolless refills, titled 'Bamboo Original' / 'Bamboo Lab' with Bambu-style colour codes and an RFID claim for Bambu AMS, at about $23-38/kg. The seller is a Shenzhen technology company; the extruder is unknown.

product_lines.name: PLA Basic (incl. refill)
product_lines.notes: 1 kg, $22.99-23.99; titles claim RFID for Bambu Lab AMS.

additional_notes: Legal entity: shenzhenshiyingzhuoyingkejiyouxiangongsi (rendering: Shenzhen Yingzhuoying Technology Co., Ltd.), Yutang Subdistrict, Guangming District, Shenzhen, Guangdong; Amazon seller 'TEWIRROW' (id A2NC27HKD3M8FD), read 2026-11-06. The listing's Manufacturer field reads 'TEWIRROW'. Store is Amazon only; no brand website was identified. A generic technology company, so the extruder is unknown. Listing titles use 'Bamboo Original' / 'Bamboo Lab' and Bambu Lab colour codes (e.g. 'Gold 13405') and claim RFID tags; that is naming that mimics Bambu Lab, not evidence of any Bambu relationship. First-pass note kept: the only US trademarks found for TEWIRROW are non-filament marks held by an individual in Shenzhen.

provenance.conflicts: The English company name is a rendering of a run-together pinyin Business Name. Whether the RFID tags are real and readable by Bambu AMS was not checked. Extruder unknown.
